reproduction.rationale: Same authentic original covariate/spike representation and original eligibility/fold metadata; any 500-ms prepared arrays or source-derived masks supplied to both conditions must be declared and pinned. No fitted GLM/grid outputs as candidate answers. Original official code and archive revisions remain as pinned in task.json/improvement.v1.json, with source fit-GLMs-rat.py and necessary loader/model dependencies curated for the code condition. Authenticate all eight-rat/eight-session-per-rat original data, units, anatomy, ZT2 mapping, movement/rate masks and original bin boundaries. Recover native tenfold membership, full grid/libraries and selection/reporting behavior without substituting new held-out splits. Recover exact fold/unit/session/rat reductions and original null/replaced-unit convention. Qualify complete native source-grid predictions and both original regional means/SDs; independent local ridge/GLM components are not author references. Freeze paired biological uncertainty across both regions, meaningful gain, reproduction tolerance, access/resource limits and complete independent execution evidence. Full-panel comparator and improvement admission require a source-faithful multi-endpoint comparison route; current scalar improvement engine cannot admit this vector. No invented mean, win count or easy source cell may replace complete support.
